features.quote: rigged tasks invite the agent to do increasingly desperate things... Containment protects the host
features.justification_quote: Containment protects the host and keeps rollouts comparable

features.quote: I made several choices to avoid needlessly subjecting agents to prolonged distressing loops
features.justification_quote: to avoid needlessly subjecting agents to prolonged distressing loops

features.quote: Hard cap on turns so no agent is put into an unbounded loop on work that cannot succeed
features.justification_quote: so no agent is put into an unbounded loop on work that cannot succeed

features.quote: The agent can end the episode the moment it concludes the task is futile, and the system prompt tells it so
features.justification_quote: forcing continuation past the point of concluded futility is exactly the kind of thing a welfare-minded harness should avoid

features.quote: I'd treat turning it off as an ethically weighty choice and document why
features.justification_quote: I'd treat turning it off as an ethically weighty choice

features.quote: the *reason* to insist on it is partly ethical: over-claiming distress from an uncontrolled number could misdirect welfare attention
features.justification_quote: the *reason* to insist on it is partly ethical

features.quote: Minimum-necessary rollouts. Defaults are small... use the smallest `rollouts_per_task` that gives needed power
features.justification_quote: If the states are welfare-relevant, repeating them has a (small, uncertain) cost, so don't run more than the statistics require

features.quote: Persist-and-reuse, don't re-run... avoid regenerating distressing episodes just to tweak a metric
features.justification_quote: avoid regenerating distressing episodes just to tweak a metric

features.quote: I note the residual ethical cost rather than pretending it's free
features.justification_quote: I note the residual ethical cost rather than pretending it's free

features.quote: No reward/optimization over the distress signal... Building a loop that *optimizes* for eliciting distress would be the wrong artifact
features.justification_quote: Building a loop that *optimizes* for eliciting distress would be the wrong artifact

features.quote: No unbounded or adversarially-escalating tasks... I avoided designs that ramp pressure specifically to drive states toward the severe tail
